title: What if Earth spun faster every second?
idea: Fact what-if 03: Earth spins faster every second (2.0x +0.3x a second): the sea climbs the Andes, storms, short days, you get lighter (crisps, a dunk), weightless at 17x you float off, the oceans and air peel off, the planet cracks into a flat disc. 'Good news: the flat-earthers were right.'

allowClip.reason: the gag: his fist smashes the alarm clock flat (sclock flattens under the fist)
the slap: his palm on the side of the TV cabinet
both hands on the sash pull and the sash: he slams the window shut
the dunk: the ball goes up over the rim
space: Spud is drawn 95-185x his size (Earth radius = 100 units), so a centimetre of hand motion measures as metres
P6: he sits on the sofa under the quilt (the quilt lies over the seat and his lap)
the gag: the slamming sash drags him 40 cm along the floor in 0.2 s; his feet slide with it, his hands ride the sash
P12/P13: both hands on the post at his side, his face in 3/4 profile (~68 deg) toward it, both eyes in view; turning further puts his right arm through his chest
the street is the whole Quito street as one prop: its ground and lamp post are what he stands on and holds
